## Day by day

### Day 1 – Mon 2027-05-10: São Jorge Castle & Lisbon Cathedral
**Weather**: light rain, 13‑17 °C (rainy). **Walk**: ~1 km.
- **16:10 Arrive in Lisbon** – Flight with SAS, see *Getting there and back*.
- **16:45 Lisbon Cathedral** – The city’s oldest church, founded in 1147 after the reconquest; blends Romanesque, Gothic and Baroque elements. Open Mon–Sat 10:00‑18:30. *ticket price: see the website* [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Alfama).
- **18:30 São Jorge Castle** – Historic fortress occupied since the 8th century BC; served as royal palace and military barracks. Open Mo‑Su 09:00‑21:00. *ticket price: see the website* [source](https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/1382432568).
- **20:30 Leitaria Camponeza** – Mid‑range dinner, try the grilled fish. Budget tier **mid**. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Baixa).

### Day 2 – Tue 2027-05-11: Belém (Jerónimos & Discoveries)
**Weather**: drizzle, 13‑18 °C (rainy). **Walk**: ~7 km.
- **10:00 Mosteiro dos Jerónimos** – Manueline masterpiece built in the 16th century, UNESCO World Heritage. Open Tue‑Sun 10:00‑18:30 (May‑Sep). *ticket €18* [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bel%C3%A9m).
- **12:30 Lunch near Belém** – Sample nearby street‑food stalls, especially pastéis de nata.
- **13:00 Monument to the Discoveries** – 1960 monument shaped like a caravel prow, commemorates the Age of Discovery; climb for views of the Tagus. *ticket €4* [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bel%C3%A9m).
- **19:00 Mercado Oriental** – Low‑budget Asian street food market, try the Macanese stall. Budget tier **low**. Open 12:00–22:30. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Baixa).

### Day 3 – Wed 2027-05-12: Eduardo VII Park area
**Weather**: rain, 13‑18 °C (rainy). **Walk**: ~1 km.
- **10:00 Museu Nacional do Desporto** – Museum of Portuguese sport heritage, free entry. Open Tu‑Su 10:00‑17:00. *free entry* [source](https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/5068486966).
- **12:30 Rosa da Rua Restaurante** – Mid‑budget lunch, buffet of Portuguese dishes. Budget tier **mid**. Open Mon‑Fri 12:00‑15:30 & 19:30‑22:30. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bairro_Alto).
- **14:00 Monumento aos Restauradores** – Monument commemorating the 1640 Restoration War that ended Spanish rule. *ticket price: see the website* [source](https://opentripmap.com/en/card/W663347630).
- **19:00 Café Buenos Aires** – High‑budget grilled meats, try the steak. Budget tier **high**. Open Mon‑Fri 16:00‑23:00, Sat 12:00‑16:00, closed Sun. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bairro_Alto).

### Day 4 – Thu 2027-05-13: Chiado
**Weather**: drizzle, 13‑20 °C (no rain). **Walk**: ~0.7 km.
- **10:00 Museu Nacional de Arte Contemporânea – Museu do Chiado** – Contemporary art collection of Portuguese and international works. Open Tu‑Su 10:00‑18:00. *ticket price: see the website* [source](https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/96321716).
- **12:30 Faca & Garfo** – Grilled Portuguese specials, mids. Budget tier **mid**. Open Mon‑Sat 08:00‑24:00. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bairro_Alto).
- **15:00 Museu Nacional do Azulejo** – Tile museum housed in the former Madre de Deus Convent, showcases azulejo art from the 15th century onward. Open Tue‑Sun 10:00‑13:00 & 14:00‑18:00, closed Mon. *ticket price: see the website* [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Alfama).
- **19:00 Alma** – Two‑Michelin‑star fine dining, try the tasting menu. Budget tier **high**. Open Tue‑Sun 12:30‑15:30 & 19:00‑22:30, closed Mon. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bairro_Alto).

### Day 5 – Fri 2027-05-14: Gulbenkian
**Weather**: overcast, 13‑20 °C (no rain). **Walk**: ~1.9 km.
- **10:00 Calouste Gulbenkian Museum** – World‑class collection of antiquities, European, Islamic and modern art. Open Su‑Mo, We‑Fr 10:00‑18:00; Sa 10:00‑21:00. *ticket price: see the website* [source](https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/188143627).
- **12:30 Os Tibetanos** – Mid‑budget vegetarian/vegan lunch, try the tofu and juice bar. Budget tier **mid**. Open Mon‑Fri 12:15‑14:45 & 19:30‑22:30, Sat 12:45‑15:30 & 20:00‑23:00. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bairro_Alto).
